name: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 - Cebu
short_description: A half-marathon event in Mandaue, Philippines, held on August 2, 2026, offering 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances.
ai_summary: The PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 - Cebu is scheduled for August 2, 2026, at Ayala Malls Gatewalk in Mandaue, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series brand, the event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, with the half marathon as the primary distance. Registration details have not yet been announced.
